<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_NightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Participation" name="Participation intended"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectBlock" name="Select starting block"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Goal_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km and measure time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Goal_Split" name="Less than 25 minutes?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrainAndCheck" name="Train and check"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GetNumber" name="Get starting number"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport_Split" name="More than one hour left before workday ends?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go there from home"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Race_Split"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run Night Run"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Drink" name="Drink while running"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Race_Join"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveTime" name="Receive final running time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalTime" name="Final running time received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Participation" targetRef="Task_SelectBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SelectBlock" targetRef="Gateway_Goal_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Goal_Merge" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Gateway_Goal_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Goal_Split" targetRef="Task_GetNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${timeUnder25Minutes}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Goal_Split" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!timeUnder25Minutes}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Goal_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_GetNumber" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Split" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreThanOneHourLeft}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Split" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!moreThanOneHourLeft}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Race_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Race_Split" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Race_Split" targetRef="Task_Drink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_Race_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_Race_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Race_Join" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTime"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
